title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on 21 December in front of "Oslo" bar
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on 21 Djetori, in front of the "Oslo" bar. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a new building with a street-side elevator, it has an area of ​​103 m², it was previously used as an office, it has a regular mortgage document and is also sold with a loan. The price is 258,000 euros.
